query: Mildred's ToGo and Catering, Fort Myers, FL
name: Mildred's ToGo and Catering
address: 3606 Michigan Ave, Fort Myers, FL 33916, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Edwin Antoine
reviewSamples.text: I've followed Mildred's from the time they were on MLK, US41 and now on Michigan Ave. Great southern food and hospitality.  It's a spot where all walks of life can come in and get a great meal. Their food doesn't miss!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of lucian jean marie
reviewSamples.text: Amazing soul food. Just had the best cat fish of my life here today. Customer service is through the roof, and I feel like I’m going to visit my family every time I come. Lord protect this place, amen.
